chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who made a false accusation against a group of people collectively.
So he عليه السلام said: “If they bring him together, he is given one hadd punishment; and if they bring him separately, he is given a hadd punishment for each one of them.”

key_terms.حَدًّا: a fixed legal punishment in the sacred law
key_terms.قَوْمٍ: a group of people against whom the accusation was made
key_terms.مُجْتَمِعِينَ: coming together collectively in one joint claim
key_terms.ٱفْتَرَى: made a false accusation or fabricated a claim

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd ruling for someone who falsely accuses a group of people in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about false accusation against multiple people. If the accused is prosecuted by them jointly, one hadd is applied; but if each comes separately, a hadd is applied for each individual claim.
